purpose: Select a conservative first-party A0-B1 catalog subset that can be independently reviewed for staging without weakening the full 115-concept research audit.
guardrails: This manifest selects a staging candidate; it does not production-approve concepts and cannot write to a database.
All selected concepts must remain first-party candidate data with FIRST_PARTY examples.
No selected concept may depend on a quarantined concept.
A0 means internal Pre-A1 bootstrap, not official CEFR-J A0 lexical or grammar certification.
Conservative later placement may be selected with a warning; unresolved earlier placement, source disagreement and identity errors are quarantined.
Grammar, phrase and skill concepts require exact type-specific audit coverage.
Any source-pack identity drift, audit drift, new concept or count change must fail closed until this manifest is reviewed again.
No selection decision may create learner state, Save/Learn intent, FSRS state, competence, exposure or Today completion.

quarantine.reason: Canonical POS/identity does not match the intended distance use. Candidate must be atomically corrected to an adverb identity before selection.
Current A2 placement is earlier than both primary and secondary lexical evidence.
Current A1 placement is earlier than both cross-checks around A2.
Reputable level sources materially disagree; preserve for explicit curriculum review.
A0 is useful survival exposure but ordinary learn-level evidence is A1+; keep out of the first import candidate until exposure-vs-learn sequencing is recorded.
A2 planning function is supported but exact collocation-level evidence remains under review.
Current skill scope conflates an A1 simple location question with A2 route-direction interaction; narrow or split before catalog import.

reviewRequirementsBeforeApply: Knowledge CI and cross-artifact integrity validator pass on the exact branch commit.
Generated starter candidate is deterministic and contains exactly the expected identities and type counts.
Preview against a read-only staging catalog snapshot has no identity collision.
Independent reviewer approves the exact candidate hash and preview plan hash.
A separate catalog-only transactional importer is reviewed; preview_import.py and build_production_starter.py remain write-free.
